about.title: about me
about.subtitle: UI design · Frontend · Full Stack
about.quote: I don't separate the design of the interface, the code that makes it work and the decision of what is worth building.
paragraphs: I come from UI design and frontend. That is where I learned to solve the visual detail, the accessibility and the behaviour of the interface before moving towards the back end, where today I work with data, authentication and deployment.

Founding 365 Días de Ajedrez forced me to decide with judgement: what to build first, what to leave out and how to communicate it. It also put me in charge of the screen design, the web development and the advertising of the product.
I am looking for a team where I can contribute to the interface without losing sight of the whole product.
